notes: The ITS_LIVE distribution on AWS carries no GEMB surface mass balance for Greenland and no GEMB field of any kind over the grounded Antarctic ice sheet; the Antarctic rows of this root cover the floating ice shelves and are labelled so in their domain column.

The ice shelf product's last quarter (time value 2017-12-16) carries no finite fac or smb over the shelves and is skipped as a non-sample by both loaders; the stamps list it under empty_steps_skipped.

The ice shelf product's fac_err field is not used: its values run to tens of metres at the median with 9999 where it has none, and its units attribute (m of ice per year) contradicts the user guide (m); the firn stamp records its percentiles and the Antarctic firn uncertainty is the stated noise floor instead.
The Greenland product carries no forcing attribute for its GEMB 1.3.0 run and no user guide was found for it on nsidc.org or in the bucket; the stamp leaves the forcing unstated rather than assumed.

The mass term's Greenland mascon set is chosen by the ice fraction rule the mass stamp states (the ITS_LIVE Greenland ice mask binned onto the mascon grid, at least 0.25 of a mascon's land area); the stamp lists the sensitivity to the threshold and the comparison with the provider's own Greenland series (trends minus 251.96 and minus 255.77 Gt per year over the same 257 months).

The ICESat-2 ATL15 granules could not be fetched from this environment (not_reachable above); the altimetric volume term is the ITS_LIVE elevation change, which shares its grid and cell set with the firn term.

The ITS_LIVE grounded Antarctic elevation change is read from 2003-01 on (the loader's --antarctic-from), since a cell set fixed over the sparse early record would keep a quarter of the sheet; the Antarctic closure refuses in any case for want of a grounded firn term.

The firn and smb stamps were regenerated on 2026-09-15 with the aggregation strings aligned with the loaders' code (the fixed cell set is finite in the value and the mean; the error field is read separately) and the Greenland DOI written bare; the CSVs are byte-identical to the earlier ones.

Both gaps this root names were searched again on 2026-09-19 and both stand. The gridded height change granules are blocked by this environment's egress policy on the distribution host and not by the product, the version or the token, so the block moves with the environment rather than with the data. The grounded Antarctic firn air content field does not exist in any NASA distributed archive, so that gap moves only if the set of sources this root is built from is widened to the modelling groups' own archives.

The firn air content of the ice shelf product was tested cell by cell rather than inferred: it is finite on all 413719 ice shelf cells and on none of the 3276620 land cells at the time steps checked, and the record mean field is finite on none of the land cells. The grounded aggregation the closure would need has no field to read.
